evidence.statement: LC-PRIM-0001 and LC-PRIM-0002 occur in the order A then B with start-to-start spacings 3035, 2943, 3036, 3029, and 2943 bp in five E. coli neighborhoods and 2969 bp in Pyrococcus; the six spacings occupy a 93-bp range.
A 5,000,000-randomization spatial null reported zero randomizations placing B within 10 kb downstream of all five E. coli A copies.
Post-freeze annotation identifies the paired regions with the ancient 16S/23S ribosomal-RNA organizational system.

This is the first literal LIFE-CODE grammar rule: two validated sequence primitives participate in a recurrent ordered neighborhood with constrained spacing, so sequence relationship carries information beyond either primitive alone.

unknowns: Which portions of the spacing constraint are mechanistically required versus historically conserved.
